title: Surveillance study of respiratory pathogens in adults hospitalised for SARI across Europe - - Update 01 Sep 2026- - New study title - - Surveillance of Respiratory Pathogens and Brand-Specific Vaccine Effectiveness in Adults Hospitalised with SARI: An Observational Study https://iddrive.eu/
summary:
We will analyse data collected during the hospitalisation of adult patients with severe acute respiratory infection (SARI). No further visits are required. The purpose of the study is to see:
•	Which viruses occur in the airways of patients hospitalised with SARI?
•	How many persons are hospitalised with a respiratory infection in the specific area/country?
•	Do these respiratory infections occur during certain times of the year?
•	Do these respiratory infections occur in patients also suffering from other diseases, such as diabetes or heart disease?
•	Have the patients been vaccinated against respiratory infections? 
•	How many people get very sick, and why do some people get more sick than others? 
•	Can vaccines protect people against severe respiratory disease?
